Ramona.name: Joyce Boysel (Joyful#1)
Ramona.text: Very timely and diagnosed and fixed the problem right away!

Ramona.name: Dennis Albert
Ramona.text:
I’m an early riser, and one recent morning at 5 a.m., I discovered that my well water had stopped working. The local company I’d used in the past was no longer in business. After searching online for a new service, I found Southern California Well Service—which, as it turns out, had actually acquired the old company.
I noted their phone number and email address, and since it was too early to call, I sent an email, planning to follow up after 8 a.m. To my surprise, I received a call from Southern California Well Service at 5:30 a.m.! We quickly scheduled an appointment.
Brian, the technician, kept me updated on his arrival time as he was delayed by issues at a prior job. Once he arrived, he quickly diagnosed the problem: a faulty capacitor. He had the replacement part on his truck, and within 20 minutes, the repair was complete. Power was restored, the pump was running properly, and water pressure returned to normal.
Southern California Well Service—and Brian in particular—exceeded my expectations. They were prompt, professional, and efficient. I highly recommend them!

Ramona.name: Jerry Sanders
Ramona.text:
Service was the same day of my call, The technician was friendly and knowledgeable. He quickly diagnosed the problem, had me up and running that day, One part was needed to permanently fix the issue.
That part was received and installed the same week.
GREAT SERVICE

Ramona.name: Patricia Donato
Ramona.text: I called with a problem and even though these folks are new to our town they came over that same morning and resolved the issue. I was a little concerned that since they had just bought out ransom  pump that they would not honor the work and warrantees from ransom pump but that is not the case. So I highly recommend if you’re a long time ransom  pump customer try these folks out. I think you will find them as responsive and helpful as their predecessor.

Ramona.name: Carlos Rivera
Ramona.text: Outstanding service!  They answered my phone call immediately, called me back quickly with an appointment time, showed up on time, explained the issue, listened to my desired solution, made the repair/replacement, and charged a fair price.  Doesn’t get better than this!

Ramona.name: miles lockhart
Ramona.text:
We got off to a rough start..
But the professionalism of haze,  and his dedication to his job! made it all work great .Thanks everybody at Southern California Well Service  🤙👍👍

Ramona.name: Lorena Marodi
Ramona.text: Brian was great! Took care of the problem quickly. I highly recommend Southern California Well System.

Ramona.name: Jan Karlseder
Ramona.text: Great, fast and competent service. Thank you!!!

Ramona.name: Mary McDowell
Ramona.text: Above and beyond the call of duty after daylight hours, Brian came to our rescue to repair well problem issues, providing this household with much needed water...than you, Brian.

Ramona.name: Jessie Boissier
Ramona.text: Luke was professional, knowledgeable, honest and efficient. He quickly diagnosed the issue and completed the repair. Highly recommend their service!

Julian.name: Richard Loomis
Julian.text: Brian showed up on time and figured out the issue really quickly. He was super helpful and offered good suggestions on how to fix it the right way. Definitely appreciated his knowledge and advice. Highly recommend Southern California Well Service.

Julian.name: Brianna McCormick
Julian.text: Thank you SC Well Service for being so fast and responding to my needs. My client has a property in Julian and was without water, you were there in less than 24 hours and fixed the problem. Thank you very much!

El Cajon.name: David Lorenz
El Cajon.text: Brian and Shaze did excellent work and they were very friendly. I was very satisfied. David Lorenz

Twentynine Palms.name: Louisa Mauk
Twentynine Palms.text: Very prompt and knowledgeable.  Got us up and running. Would highly recommend their company.

Anza.name: Kevin Wilkes
Anza.text: Saving thousand dollars over another estimate. Quick response. Extremely satisfied

San Diego.name: Hortensia Badeanlou
San Diego.text:
5 Stars
I had a wonderful experience with Southern Water Well Company. The young men who came were very professional, respectful, and considerate throughout the whole process. They did their work with care and kindness, and I truly appreciated their attitude and service. Thank you very much! I highly recommend them.

Hemet.name: Maggie
Hemet.text: Great company to work with. They acted fast and got the job done. I highly recommend this company

Valley Center.name: Tracy Hege
Valley Center.text: Technicians arrived on time and friendly and knowledgeable.

Escondido.name: Tyler
Escondido.text: These guys are amazing professionals, who seemed to really care. They provided multiple options for a replacement pump based on my needs and were able to quickly install everything.

Escondido.name: john baldwin
Escondido.text:
This has been my go to well service for over 10 years. You will be most impressed by their constant contact and prompt service. They explain things clearly and honor all warranties with no run around. My well had to be pulled after a motor failure and the entire process took less than 3 days with warranty coverage, and small charge to me. The owner, Brighton, even got involved and replaced some items free of charge to assure constant service.
Thank you to all involved.

Lakeside.name: Kathy Bast
Lakeside.text: The technician was very friendly and helpful! I would highly recommend.

Costa Mesa.name: Margaret Long
Costa Mesa.text: Southern California Well Service was extremely competent and professional. They took care of business in a friendly manner  were very knowledgeable.

Poway.name: Teresa Kassen
Poway.text: We got a fault on our booster pump system leaving us without water essentially.  We are retired and cost matters to us.  We were having trouble finding a local business to work with on this repair but we found Southern California Well Services and I am so glad we did.  They keep you informed (without overkill).  They were absolutely fantastic to work with.  They were efficient, expedient, and very professional!  Pricing was very fair.  In less than 24 hrs of first contact, we had water again.  I am sure some issues may cause a longer turn around time but I wouldn’t use anyone else!

Poway.name: Mark Stidham
Poway.text: I had an emergency ‘no water in the house’, our setting being 200’ above street level. Water pressure comes from a 7,000 gallon tank that had run dry. A short time after logging my request for service, I got a call back and a promise to be on site in 30 minutes! I also got 2 separate follow-up calls to make sure.

Winchester.name: Larry Donald
Winchester.text: Great company quick very competent and knowledgeable. I wouldn't use any one else.

Menifee.name: Kathleen Hefley
Menifee.text: They are Life savers, super knowledgeable, and professional and they get the job done!!!! I recommend them to everyone. We woke up to problem at the well and no running water. I reached out to them before sunrise hoping they would get a message first thing. Then Wow, they reached out right away! We Got scheduled and a couple hours later they had identified the problem and were making repairs. I am so grateful to them for taking great care of me and my family. We appreciate them so much! If you have a well issue, you can definitely count on them.

Alpine.name: Darlene Jean
Alpine.text: Answered my call quickly, tech sent out within 1 1/2 hours. Determined what problem was and was very thorough when fixing it.  Looked over my entire well to ensure that all was working well. Would highly recommend this well service!!  Tech Brian was great.

Aguanga.name: Cathy Lynch
Aguanga.text: They were able to come out and repair our well the same day we called!  Great service:)

Temecula.name: Don Elmore
Temecula.text: On time, hard workers, very knowledgeable!

Jamul.name: Lorene Kellogg
Jamul.text:
Had a hard time getting a well service to fix our well that was very, very slow..  Called some local companies that either did not return our calls or we heard from them to discuss the issue and then we couldn't reach them to finalize when they would do the work.  We were very frustrated after a month trying.

We then made one more attempt by contacting Southern California Well Service that we found online.  Someone called back right away - a real person.  They had a next day appointment.  They came at the scheduled time and pulled up the pipe and pump.  Said the pipe is still good.  Gave a quote that we agreed to and they honored the quote.  They replaced the pump and motor and put new fittings on the pipe and got the system up and running in about 5 hours.  This included their trip to get supplies.  They were very professional and we could pay by credit card online.  The system is now working great again.  We were happy and relieved to have our system working so well.

Vista.name: Jane Frank
Vista.text: The technician was excellent in troubleshooting our water problems with a complex well, reverse osmosis system, and water storage tank system. The technician methodically tested all variables in our system and was able to accurately identify that a solenoid in our RO system was not working properly. Once we had it replaced, the whole system is working properly. This has been an ongoing problem for months if not years, so thank you for finally finding the solution!
